title: BIT Alumni Connect
description: Comprehensive alumni management and engagement platform designed and delivered for Bannari Amman Institute of Technology with multi-tier role-based access, automated campus visit approvals, and cryptographically verified virtual IDs.
problemSolved: Alumni networks and educational institutions struggle with disconnected records, manual campus visitor tracking, unverified alumni identities, and fragmented communication between graduates, students, faculty, and campus security.
myRole: Designed and delivered the entire full-stack platform independently. Architected 26 relational database entities, designed and implemented ~100 secure REST endpoints, integrated role-based security, built the responsive React web client, and configured containerized deployment across Vercel, Render, and Neon.
features: Multi-role access control for Alumni, Students, Staff, Watchmen, and Admins
Searchable alumni directory with graduation year, department, and company filters
Campus visit request submission with multi-tier administrative approval workflow
Dynamic virtual alumni ID cards featuring tamper-resistant QR verification
Security watchman gate-entry scanning and real-time pass validation
Alumni profile-change submission and administrative review workflow
Community feed for announcements, professional updates, and discussions
Events management module with RSVP tracking and campus scheduling
15 distinct feature modules with ~100 secure REST endpoints and 26 JPA database entities
challenges: Architecting a highly scalable relational data model with 26 interconnected entities while enforcing granular role-based permissions across 5 distinct user roles without authorization leaks or performance bottlenecks.
lessonsLearned: Deepened production engineering expertise in Spring Security RBAC, JPA relationship management, Docker containerization, and coordinating multi-cloud deployments across Vercel, Render, and Neon PostgreSQL.

title: AI-Powered Smart Survey Platform
description: Multimodal, multilingual survey and polling platform built for MoSPI Statathon 2025. Enables survey creation with AI assistance and delivers accessible surveys to citizens via web portal, WhatsApp, and SMS with multilingual translation and semantic analysis.
problemSolved: Government survey initiatives struggle with low citizen participation, linguistic barriers across diverse demographics, complex survey distribution mechanisms, and delayed analysis of textual citizen responses.
myRole: Led team CODE SENTINELS (4 members). Designed the multi-service architecture, integrated Twilio WhatsApp and SMS distribution, integrated Bhashini speech-to-text, text-to-speech and multilingual translation APIs, and integrated the open-source LLM pipeline with RAG and semantic search in the FastAPI service.
features: AI-assisted survey builder for government officials
Omnichannel survey delivery across Web, WhatsApp, and SMS
Bhashini integration for Indian language voice input and localized translation
Semantic search and RAG-based analysis over unstructured citizen feedback
Real-time analytics dashboard for response trends and demographic breakdown
Multi-service communication connecting Spring Boot core and FastAPI AI service
challenges: Coordinating seamless data exchange between a Spring Boot transaction backend, a Python FastAPI AI inference engine, and external telecommunication and speech APIs under high concurrency.
lessonsLearned: Gained substantial technical leadership experience steering a 4-person engineering team, architecting hybrid Java/Python micro-services, and optimizing RAG pipelines with localized embeddings.

title: AI Learning Roadmap Generator
description: Personalised learning roadmap generator that performs rule-based skill-gap analysis enriched by Groq LLM generation with fallback resilience, secure refresh tokens, and administrative management.
problemSolved: Self-taught developers and students face information overload and lack tailored, structured learning trajectories that bridge specific skill gaps between current capabilities and target job roles.
myRole: Designed and delivered the complete application from scratch. Designed rule-based skill-gap analysis, integrated Groq LLM API with automated fallback handling, designed JWT authentication with secure refresh tokens, delivered an administrative dashboard, and integrated automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
features: Rule-based skill-gap evaluation mapping current skills against target roles
Dynamic learning roadmap generation enriched by Groq LLM API
Automated fallback generator maintaining service availability if LLM API is unreachable
Robust JWT authentication architecture utilizing short-lived access and secure refresh tokens
Comprehensive administrative dashboard managing courses, roadmaps, and users
Automated lint and build continuous integration via GitHub Actions
~40 REST API endpoints with structured request validation
challenges: Guaranteeing deterministic curriculum generation even during third-party LLM rate limits or outages by integrating a resilient rule-based algorithmic fallback.
lessonsLearned: Mastered token refresh rotations, defensive LLM API integration with exponential backoff, and GitHub Actions continuous integration pipelines.

title: Battery Vehicle Booking System
description: Role-based booking and dispatch management platform for campus battery vehicles, serving students, campus security watchmen, and transportation administrators with real-time status tracking.
problemSolved: Campus electric transit operations faced uncoordinated vehicle requests, scheduling collisions, lack of accountability during dispatch, and manual gate logs by security personnel.
myRole: Designed and delivered the multi-tier role-based booking portal. Integrated distinct portals for students, watchmen, and administrators. Designed and delivered the live MERN architecture, and developed a Spring Boot + TiDB migration on a dedicated branch.
features: Student reservation portal with conflict-free slot scheduling
Administrative approval, queue prioritization, and fleet management dashboard
Watchman dispatch and return logging interface with gate clearance verification
Real-time trip status lifecycle tracking (Requested, Approved, Dispatched, Completed)
Production MERN deployment on Vercel with Spring Boot + TiDB relational migration branch
challenges: Restructuring an active document-based MongoDB schema into normalized relational entities in Spring Boot + TiDB while maintaining identical API responses.
lessonsLearned: Practical experience with relational schema migrations, cross-stack backend parity testing, and managing campus role authorization workflows.
